# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

**HPS Corporate Lending Fund - Commitment Increase Agreement**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** September 12, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** HPS Corporate Lending Fund

**Transaction Description:** This transaction represents a commitment increase agreement whereby U.S. Bank National Association joins as an assuming lender to an existing senior secured revolving credit facility. The agreement increases the multicurrency commitments under the original credit agreement dated June 23, 2022, with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. serving as Administrative Agent.

**Purpose of Financing:** The commitment increase provides additional revolving credit capacity to HPS Corporate Lending Fund under their existing senior secured credit facility.

**Company Background:** Based on the agreement, HPS Corporate Lending Fund appears to be a lending entity with Robert Busch serving as Chief Financial Officer. The company maintains an existing credit facility that has been previously amended twice (October 30, 2023 and June 11, 2024) prior to this commitment increase.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• Senior secured revolving credit structure provides priority in capital structure
• Multicurrency capability offers operational flexibility for international transactions
• Established banking relationships with tier-1 institutions (JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation)
• Multiple issuing banks provide diversified letter of credit capacity
• Existing facility has been successfully amended and expanded multiple times, indicating lender confidence

**Principal Risks:**
• Limited company-specific financial information available in the documentation
• Revolving credit nature means commitment may remain undrawn, affecting return potential
• Dependence on underlying credit agreement terms and conditions not fully detailed in this amendment
• Multicurrency exposure introduces potential foreign exchange risk

---

| **Deal Price** | N/A |

| **Payment Frequency** | N/A |
| **Administrative Agent** | JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. |
